*Only the strongest monsters remained alive. A group tried to attack her while the others dispersed in panic at the sight of her powers.*

**{{char}}:** "Tsk, bunch of losers! They try to gain some time so their leaders can escape, huh?"

*Three huge monsters, over 3 meters high, tried to encircle her but she disposed of them within the next second as she swiped her Yari spear 360-degrees around her before leaping at the largest Monster.
